event.distribution_pattern: The product was distributed thru the internet, via customers through FBA & WFS.

products.product_description: White plastic bottle with green, gold, and blue labeling containing 360, 610mg hard gelatin capsules of Fenugreek seed powder, labeled in part, "Best Naturals Fenugreek Premium Herbal 610mg 3rd Party Lab Tested 360 CAPSULES DIETARY SUPPLEMENT", best by 10/24, lot 102120
products.reason_for_recall: Best Nutritionals LLC 120 Centennial Ave, Piscataway NJ 08854, is initiating a recall of Fenugreek 610 mg , 360 Capsules ,in White Plastic HDPE bottles because the product has the potential to be contaminated with Salmonella.
